tiles: DoGooder Award winner — #1 Funny for Good
Shorty Awards finalist — Behind the Leather
Organic viral reach without paid amplification
challenge: Nonprofit advocacy campaigns face unique distribution challenges — limited budgets, sensitive subject matter, and audiences resistant to being preached at. The goal was to drive massive awareness for animal rights issues through shareable content that audiences would voluntarily spread, without relying on shock tactics or large media buys.
approach: Developed comedy-driven video content that reframed serious advocacy messaging into genuinely entertaining formats. The Tofucken campaign leaned into holiday cooking humor to make plant-based eating approachable. Behind the Leather used investigative storytelling to create emotional resonance. Each campaign was purpose-built for organic social sharing, with timing, format, and platform selection optimized for maximum earned media pickup.
result: The Tofucken video surpassed 100M+ views and won the DoGooder Award for #1 Funny for Good. Behind the Leather became a Shorty Awards finalist, generating 40M+ organic views and widespread press coverage. The Shoot Selfies Not Animals campaign extended reach through participatory social mechanics. These campaigns demonstrated that advocacy messaging works best when audiences choose to share it rather than having it pushed to them.
